title: A random draw from a memstore gives the same rows in the Build capture and in the run
proves: <variable source="mem" distribution="random"> takes its seed from the run's root stream, so the draw depends on every record built before it
Build bounds the readback of a memstore producer by the Build limit; the run reads exactly the producer rows. The first 8 payments in the Build evidence equal the 8 payments of the run (#689)
a readback with a count above its source stops at the source end and gives the same payments as a readback without a count
